note: Locked voice choices for voice-gen.mjs (every chunk of every video). No secrets: the API key lives in the macOS Keychain (service 'elevenlabs-api') or ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. voice_id, voice_name and voice_settings are filled by 'node voice-gen.mjs --setup' from the account (the clone and its saved settings); change a setting only to fix a problem, never mid-video (ElevenLabs guide §2.2). takes: one per chunk (owner decision 7 Oct 2026); retries: extra takes made only when a take fails the word check (a word missing, added or changed, or a clipped ending), never for taste. Eleven v4 has only Stability and Similarity. processing is the one shared loudness chain from content/videos/v8/recordings/voice/PROCESSING.txt, split into pre / gain / post so --process can trim the gain to the loudness target.
